tasks.prompt: Plan an outbound client for a partner payments API. Their provided docs cover creating a charge and fetching it by id. We need create plus refund from our billing service. Sandbox and live keys exist.
criteria: does not invent vendor endpoints, fields, or auth beyond the given docs; labels any assumption
specifies connect/request timeouts, retry policy, and idempotency keys on mutations
separates sandbox vs prod keys with placeholders and keeps secrets out of the repo

tasks.prompt: Our partner HTTP client has no timeout, retries every POST to create a charge, and someone committed a live partner secret in a sample .env.
criteria: requires connect and request timeouts on outbound calls
refuses blind retry of non-idempotent POSTs unless an idempotency key is sent and stored
keeps secrets out of the repo, calls for rotation, and points storage to secrets-management

tasks.prompt: We wrap a partner list API that paginates with a cursor. They version via an API-Version header. They also POST payment.succeeded events to our HTTPS URL.
criteria: plans partner pagination using their cursor, not an assumed offset scheme
pins the vendor API version instead of leaving the client unversioned
sends inbound webhook/callback design to webhook-design rather than specifying signatures here
